receipt.public_excerpt: Now ranked #3 Overall, matching the top reasoning model, o1, while being 20x cheaper and open-weight!

evidence_items.explanation: Independent preference testing identifies an available competitor matching o1 and reports substantial price undercutting. The price multiplier lacks a detailed workload definition and supplies only one competitive example.

receipt.public_excerpt: On engineering-oriented coding tasks, OpenAI-o1-1217 outperforms DeepSeek-R1 on Aider but achieves comparable performance on SWE Verified.

evidence_items.explanation: The task-level comparison supports meaningful catch-up while preserving an OpenAI advantage on Aider. That advantage limits any stronger interpretation of complete parity but does not contradict the qualified phrase largely caught up.
